name_zh: 阿富汗部落/杜兰线/联邦制/地缘政治
description_zh: 阿富汗部落社会包括普什图人、塔吉克人、哈扎拉人等，在杜兰线争议背景下发展出独特的部落联邦制，强调传统权威与现代治理结合，面对苏联入侵、塔利班统治、美国占领等历史变迁，探索后冲突国家建设道路。
description_en: Afghan tribal society including Pashtuns, Tajiks, Hazaras, etc., developed unique tribal federal system under Durand Line dispute, emphasize combination of traditional authority and modern governance, face Soviet invasion, Taliban rule, US occupation and other historical changes, explore post-conflict nation building path.
reason_zh: 阿富汗部落联邦制代表传统治理模式如何适应现代国家建设，展示了部落政治如何在冲突环境中维持秩序，其联邦制影响了区域治理创新，其地缘政治影响了南亚安全格局，其文化遗产影响了国家认同建构。
reason_en: Afghan tribal federal system represents how traditional governance models adapt to modern nation building, demonstrates how tribal politics maintain order in conflict environments, its federal system influences regional governance innovation, its geopolitics affects South Asian security landscape, its cultural heritage influences national identity construction.
steps_zh: 研究阿富汗部落结构/传统权威/决策机制
分析杜兰线争议/殖民遗产/地缘政治
探讨苏联入侵/抵抗运动/权力真空
评估塔利班统治/美国占领/和平进程
总结联邦制挑战/传统治理/现代转型/未来前景
steps_en: Study Afghan tribal structure/traditional authority/decision-making mechanisms
Summarize federal system challenges/traditional governance/modern transformation/future prospects
expected_zh: 理解传统治理模式如何适应现代国家建设，掌握部落政治的核心运作机制，评估联邦制对区域治理的影响，认识地缘政治在冲突解决中的作用。
expected_en: Understand how traditional governance models adapt to modern nation building, grasp core operational mechanisms of tribal politics, evaluate federal system impact on regional governance, recognize geopolitics role in conflict resolution.
case_zh: 1893年杜兰线协议；1979年苏联入侵；2001年美国占领；2021年塔利班回归。部落联邦/地缘政治/冲突解决/国家重建。
case_en: 1893 Durand Line Agreement; 1979 Soviet Invasion; 2001 US Occupation; 2021 Taliban Return. Tribal federation/Geopolitics/Conflict resolution/National reconstruction.
cross_cultural_impact: Central Asian politics/Islamic world/Tribal networks/Regional security/Cultural identity
conflict_resolution_mechanism: 部落调解/宗教权威/国际干预
